long_description.before: Most health companies profit when you buy more tests. Mito profits when you make better decisions. Take a 60-second quiz → get a personalized recommendation: what to test, what to skip, what it costs. Every lab at our published cost (members pay exactly that; non-members +10%). Clinician-reviewed next steps, longitudinal tracking, and an AI Concierge that builds you a panel. $9/mo, cancel anytime. HSA/FSA eligible.
long_description.after:
Mito Health is a U.S. service that lets individuals order more than 1,000 laboratory markers, panels, scans, and at-home kits without going through a traditional doctor’s visit. Members pay $9 per month to access every test at the company’s published cost, see itemized receipts with no hidden mark-ups, and receive priority turnaround on results. 

After answering an online questionnaire, users receive personalized test recommendations, can schedule a nearby draw at the lowest available price, and obtain clinician-reviewed action plans that cover sleep, supplements, exercise, and other lifestyle factors. The platform also allows members to upload past lab data, view longitudinal trends, and chat year-round with clinicians or AI health coaching through the built-in Mito Concierge.

A growing number of states require employers to provide: (1) Notice when automation is used to make decisions, (2) explanations of how automated decisions were made, and (3) options to opt out of or appeal automated decisions.

Chicory connects to applications where hiring, employment, and contracting decisions are made and takes care of notices, explanations, recourse, and risk assessments.

long_description.before:
Bloom is the brand layer for agents - it turns brand into infrastructure that any agent, app, or platform can call.

Ingest your brand from anywhere - decks, websites, social, Figma, and more.
Bloom systemises your brand, enabling the creation of on-brand outputs like images, video, video, copy, and more, through the web app, the API, or MCP.

long_description.after:
Bloom is the brand layer for agents. It turns a brand’s identity, guidance, and assets into shared context that agents and products can use. That context evolves with the brand, alongside the tools where it is created and managed.

Starting with websites, social media, and files, Bloom develops and maintains versioned brand context. Through MCP or the API, connected agents and products can retrieve and update that context, then apply it to images, websites, slides, video, copy, and other brand work.

We’re an ai infra company making brand as operable as software.

long_description.before: GodHands makes employee transitions seamless and ensures that critical knowledge is captured for posterity. We reconstruct any employee’s work in days from the systems where they did it. You can see what depends on them, hand their role over, and keep their work running after they leave.
long_description.after: GodHands learns how your teams actually work, capturing the steps, decisions, and exceptions that never get written down. It turns that knowledge into living playbooks and answers with sources, so people and AI agents can put it to work. Teams use GodHands to run operations, onboard employees, hand over roles, integrate acquisitions, and automate work.

long_description.before:
CONUS is the AI knowledge layer for surgery, connecting medical device manufacturers with hospitals. We bring product information, hospital protocols and medical research together, helping doctors and sales reps find answers in seconds.

We already work with leading manufacturers including Johnson & Johnson, Stryker and Zimmer Biomet. Our long-term ambition is to let hospitals select and order implants from all manufacturers on one platform: Amazon for implants, embedded in the surgical workflow.
long_description.after:
CONUS structures fragmented medical device information for surgeons. We combine manufacturer documentation, hospital protocols and medical research in one place, giving surgeons and MedTech teams reliable answers across products and procedures.

We already work with leading manufacturers including Johnson & Johnson, Stryker and Zimmer Biomet, and since launching six months ago we’ve gone live in 18 hospitals.

Long term, hospitals will use CONUS to select and order implants across manufacturers.
